Gold Answer: Approval by at least a two-thirds majority of the total number of then members of both Houses.

Question: संकटकाल घोषणा गरी एक महिनाभित्र दुवै सदनमा पेश गरिएपछि कायम रहन थप कुन शर्त आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: तत्काल कायम रहेका दुवै सदनका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा दुई तिहाइ बहुमतबाट अनुमोदन।
Gemma Answer: दुबै सदनले संसद्को मतले अनुमोदन गर्यो।

Question: What is the difference between the approval deadline and the validity period of an approved emergency declaration?
Gold Answer: Approval must occur within one month, while an approved declaration remains for three months from issuance.
Gemma Answer: The approval deadline is the date by which the declaration must be implemented. The validity period is the length of time the declaration remains in effect after approval.

Question: संकटकाल अनुमोदनको समयसीमा र अनुमोदनपछि कायम रहने अवधिबीच के फरक छ?
Gold Answer: अनुमोदन एक महिनाभित्र हुनुपर्छ भने अनुमोदन भएको घोषणा जारी भएको मितिबाट तीन महिनासम्म कायम रहन्छ।
Gemma Answer: समयसीमा र अनुमोदनपछि कायम रहने अवधिबीचको फरक संकटकालको उद्देश्य पूरा भएपछि स्वतः समाप्त हुन्छ।

Question: Before the expiry of an emergency declaration, for how long can a motion be submitted to extend the emergency period?
Gold Answer: Another period not exceeding three months.

Question: संकटकालको अवधि समाप्त हुनुअघि कति अवधिसम्म थप गर्न प्रस्ताव पेश गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer: थप तीन महिनाभन्दा बढी नहुने अवधि।

Question: What majority is required for the Federal Parliament to extend the period of a state of emergency?
Gold Answer: At least two-thirds majority of the total number of then members of both Houses.

Question: संकटकालको अवधि थप गर्न संघीय संसदमा कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: तत्काल कायम रहेका दुवै सदनका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा दुई तिहाइ बहुमत।

Question: If the House of Representatives has been dissolved during an emergency, which body exercises the Federal Parliament’s emergency-related powers?
Gold Answer: The National Assembly.

Question: संकटकाल कायम रहेको अवस्थामा प्रतिनिधि सभा विघटन भए संघीय संसदको संकटकालसम्बन्धी अधिकार कसले प्रयोग गर्छ?
Gold Answer: राष्ट्रिय सभा।

Question: What authority does the President have after declaring a state of emergency to address emergency situations?
Gold Answer: The President may issue necessary orders to meet the exigencies.
Gemma Answer: The President gains broad authority to take immediate action, including deploying federal resources, suspending certain regulations, and modifying laws, subject to congressional oversight.

Question: संकटकाल घोषणा भएपछि आपतकालीन अवस्था समाधान गर्न राष्ट्रपतिसँग कस्तो अधिकार हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: राष्ट्रपतिले आवश्यक आदेश जारी गर्न सक्छन्।
Gemma Answer: राष्ट्रपति आपतकालीन अवस्थाको समाधान गर्न अध्यादेश जारी गर्न र कानुन बनाउन सक्छन्।

Question: During a state of emergency, what is the legal status of orders issued by the President under Article 273(9)?
Gold Answer: They apply as law while the state of emergency is in operation.
Gemma Answer: These orders have the force of law.

Question: धारा २७३(९) अनुसार राष्ट्रपतिले जारी गरेका आदेशहरूको कानुनी स्थिति के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: संकटकाल कायम रहँदासम्म ती आदेश कानुनसरह लागू हुन्छन्।
Gemma Answer: राष्ट्रपति आदेशहरू संवैधानिक आदेशको रूपमा गणनीय हुन्छन्।

Question: Which category of rights may be suspended during a state of emergency?
Gold Answer: Fundamental rights provided in Part-3, subject to constitutional exceptions.

Question: संकटकालको समयमा कुन प्रकारका अधिकार निलम्बन गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer: भाग–३ मा प्रदान गरिएका मौलिक हकहरू, संविधानमा तोकिएका अपवाद बाहेक।
Gemma Answer: अहिंसा, अभिव्यक्ति, सभा, र छूतका अधिकार।

Question: Are all fundamental rights suspended during a state of emergency?
Gold Answer: No, specified rights and remedies cannot be suspended.

Question: के संकटकालमा सबै मौलिक हकहरू निलम्बन हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer: होइन, तोकिएका मौलिक हक र उपचारका अधिकार निलम्बन गर्न सकिँदैन।
Gemma Answer: नहीँ, सबै मौलिक हकहरू निलम्बन हुँदैनन्।

Question: Which constitutional remedy specifically remains protected and cannot be suspended during an emergency?
Gold Answer: The remedy of habeas corpus.

Question: संकटकालमा कुन संवैधानिक उपचारको अधिकार निलम्बन गर्न सकिँदैन?
Gold Answer: बन्दी प्रत्यक्षीकरणको उपचार।

Question: Can a petition be filed in court to enforce a suspended fundamental right during an emergency?
Gold Answer: No, no petition may lie for enforcement of that suspended right.

Question: संकटकालमा निलम्बित मौलिक हक कार्यान्वयनका लागि अदालतमा निवेदन दिन सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer: सकिँदैन, त्यस्तो निलम्बित हक कार्यान्वयनका लागि निवेदन लाग्दैन।

Question: If a person suffers injury due to an official’s bad faith action during emergency, within what period may compensation be claimed after termination of the emergency?
Gold Answer: Within three months from the date of termination.
Gemma Answer: Generally, within six months of termination of the emergency.

Question: संकटकालमा अधिकारीको बदनियतपूर्ण कार्यबाट क्षति भएमा संकटकाल समाप्त भएपछि कति अवधिभित्र क्षतिपूर्तिको माग गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer: समाप्त भएको मितिले तीन महिनाभित्र।

Question: Who may order compensation or punishment when a valid petition is filed for injury caused during an emergency?
Gold Answer: The court.

Question: संकटकालको समयमा भएको क्षतिका लागि निवेदन परेमा क्षतिपूर्ति वा सजायको आदेश कसले दिन सक्छ?
Gold Answer: अदालतले।

Question: Who may withdraw a declaration or order of a state of emergency?
Gold Answer: The President.

Question: संकटकाल घोषणा वा आदेश फिर्ता गर्ने अधिकार कसलाई हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: राष्ट्रपति।

Question: What is the difference between approval of an emergency declaration and extension of an emergency period?
Gold Answer: Approval requires two-thirds majority after issuance, while extension requires a separate two-thirds majority motion before expiry.
Gemma Answer: Approval initiates the emergency; extension continues it.

Question: संकटकाल घोषणा अनुमोदन र संकटकाल अवधि थप गर्ने प्रक्रियाबीच के फरक छ?
Gold Answer: घोषणा अनुमोदनका लागि जारी भएपछि दुई तिहाइ बहुमत आवश्यक हुन्छ भने अवधि थपका लागि समाप्त हुनुअघि छुट्टै दुई तिहाइ बहुमतको प्रस्ताव आवश्यक हुन्छ।
Gemma Answer: संकटकाल घोषणा अनुमोदन गर्दा मन्त्रीको हस्ताक्षर आवश्यक हुन्छ, तर संकटकाल अवधि थप गर्ने प्रक्रियामा राष्ट्रपतिले हस्ताक्षर गर्छन्।

Question: Arrange the correct constitutional sequence after a state of emergency is declared by the President.
Gold Answer: Declaration → submission to both Houses within one month → approval by two-thirds majority → continuation for specified period.
Gemma Answer:
1.  President issues executive orders.
2.  Congress can pass a concurrent resolution overriding executive orders (requires 2/3 vote in both houses).
3.  Congress can pass legislation related to the emergency.
4.  State governments continue to operate, but with limitations.

Question: राष्ट्रपतिले संकटकाल घोषणा गरेपछि संविधानअनुसार सही प्रक्रिया क्रम मिलाउनुहोस्।
Gold Answer: घोषणा → एक महिनाभित्र दुवै सदनमा पेश → दुई तिहाइ बहुमतबाट अनुमोदन → तोकिएको अवधिसम्म कायम।
Gemma Answer:
1. संसद्को बैठक आह्वान
2. राष्ट्रपतिको ভাষণ
3. संसद्ले कानून पारित गर्ने

Question: What limitation does the Constitution impose on the amendment of the Constitution?
Gold Answer: An amendment must not prejudice sovereignty, territorial integrity, independence of Nepal, or sovereignty vested in the people.
Gemma Answer: It requires a supermajority vote in Congress and ratification by three-fourths of the states.

Question: संविधान संशोधन गर्दा संविधानले कुन सीमाना तोकेको छ?
Gold Answer: संशोधनले नेपालको सार्वभौमसत्ता, भौगोलिक अखण्डता, स्वतन्त्रता वा जनतामा निहित सार्वभौमसत्तामा प्रतिकूल असर पार्नु हुँदैन।
Gemma Answer: संविधानले संशोधनको विषय, प्रक्रिया र आवश्यकताबारे सीमाना तोकेको छ।

Question: Can the Constitution be amended in a manner that affects the sovereignty vested in the people?
Gold Answer: No.

Question: के जनतामा निहित सार्वभौमसत्तामा असर पर्ने गरी संविधान संशोधन गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer: सकिँदैन।
Gemma Answer: नाही, जनतामा निहित सार्वभौमसत्तामा असर पर्ने गरी संविधान संशोधन गर्न पाइँदैन।

Question: Which body may introduce a bill to amend or repeal any Article of the Constitution?
Gold Answer: Either House of the Federal Parliament.

Question: संविधानको कुनै धारा संशोधन वा खारेज गर्ने विधेयक कुन निकायमा पेश गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer: संघीय संसदको कुनै पनि सदनमा।

Question: Which clause of Article 274 itself cannot be amended?
Gold Answer: Clause (1).
Gemma Answer: The provisions relating to the composition of the Council.

Question: धारा २७४ को कुन उपधारा आफैं संशोधन गर्न सकिँदैन?
Gold Answer: उपधारा (१)।

Question: What type of legislative proposal may be introduced under Article 274(2)?
Gold Answer: A bill to amend or repeal any Article of the Constitution.
Gemma Answer: A proposal for a European Union Directive.

Question: धारा २७४(२) अनुसार कस्तो विधेयक पेश गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer: संविधानको कुनै पनि धारा संशोधन वा खारेज गर्ने विधेयक।
Gemma Answer: संविधानको धारा २७४(२) अनुसार राष्ट्रपतिले प्रतिनिधिसभाको छोटो अवकाश्यमा पनि विधेयक प्रस्तुत गर्न सक्छन्।

Question: Within how many days must an introduced constitutional amendment bill be publicly published for information?
Gold Answer: Within thirty days of introduction.

Question: पेश गरिएको संविधान संशोधन विधेयक सार्वजनिक जानकारीका लागि कति दिनभित्र प्रकाशित गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer: पेश भएको तीस दिनभित्र।

Question: What is the purpose of publishing an amendment bill within thirty days?
Gold Answer: To provide information to the general public.

Question: संविधान संशोधन विधेयक तीस दिनभित्र प्रकाशित गर्नुको उद्देश्य के हो?
Gold Answer: सर्वसाधारण जनतालाई जानकारी दिनु।
Gemma Answer: संशोधन प्रक्रियाको समयसीमा निर्धारण गर्नु र राजनीतिक प्रक्रियामा गति लभ्ना सुनिश्चित गर्नु।

Question: When must an amendment bill be sent to the State Assembly for consent?
Gold Answer: When it relates to alteration of State borders or matters in Schedule-6.
Gemma Answer: Upon receipt of a petition signed by at least one-tenth of the total number of registered voters of the State.

Question: कुन अवस्थामा संविधान संशोधन विधेयक प्रदेश सभाको सहमतिका लागि पठाउनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer: प्रदेशको सीमाना परिवर्तन वा अनुसूची–६ का विषयसँग सम्बन्धित भएमा।
Gemma Answer: संविधान संशोधन विधेयक प्रदेश सभाको दुई तिहाई मतले पारित नहुँदा सम्म प्रदेश सभाको सहमतिका लागि पठाउनुपर्छ।

Question: Who sends an amendment bill to the State Assembly for consent?
Gold Answer: The Speaker or Chairperson of the concerned House.

Question: संविधान संशोधन विधेयक प्रदेश सभाको सहमतिका लागि कसले पठाउँछ?
Gold Answer: सम्बन्धित सदनका सभामुख वा अध्यक्षले।
Gemma Answer: संविधान संशोधन विधेयक संसयको सहमतिका लागि राष्ट्रपति पठाउँछन्।

Question: Within how many days after introduction in the Federal Parliament must a relevant amendment bill be sent to the State Assembly?
Gold Answer: Within thirty days after its introduction.

Question: सम्बन्धित संविधान संशोधन विधेयक संघीय संसदमा पेश भएपछि कति दिनभित्र प्रदेश सभामा पठाउनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer: पेश भएको तीस दिनभित्र।

Question: What majority is required for a State Assembly to accept or reject an amendment bill sent for consent?
Gold Answer: Majority of the total number of its then members.

Question: सहमतिका लागि पठाइएको संशोधन विधेयक स्वीकार वा अस्वीकार गर्न प्रदेश सभामा कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल सदस्य संख्याको बहुमत।

Question: Within what period must the State Assembly provide information about acceptance or rejection of an amendment bill?
Gold Answer: Within three months.

Question: प्रदेश सभाले संशोधन विधेयक स्वीकार वा अस्वीकार गरेको जानकारी कति अवधिभित्र दिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer: तीन महिनाभित्र।

Question: What happens if a State Assembly does not provide information of acceptance or rejection of an amendment bill within the prescribed period?
Gold Answer: The Federal Parliament may proceed with the bill.
Gemma Answer: The bill lapses and is no longer considered for that legislative session.

Question: तोकिएको अवधिभित्र प्रदेश सभाले संशोधन विधेयक स्वीकार वा अस्वीकार गरेको जानकारी नदिएमा के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: संघीय संसदले विधेयकमाथि प्रक्रिया अगाडि बढाउन सक्छ।

Question: What is the consequence if a State Assembly rejects an amendment bill by majority and informs the Federal Parliament within the required period?
Gold Answer: The bill becomes inoperative.

Question: प्रदेश सभाले बहुमतबाट संशोधन विधेयक अस्वीकार गरी समयभित्र संघीय संसदलाई जानकारी दिएमा के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: विधेयक निष्क्रिय हुन्छ।
Gemma Answer: विधेयक पारित हुन सकेको नहुँदा संघीय संसदमा प्रस्तुत गर्ने समयसीमा सकिन्छ।

Question: What majority is required to pass an amendment bill that does not require State Assembly consent?
Gold Answer: At least two-thirds majority of the total number of then members of both Houses of the Federal Parliament.

Question: प्रदेश सभाको सहमति आवश्यक नपर्ने संशोधन विधेयक पारित गर्न कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: संघीय संसदका दुवै सदनका तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा दुई तिहाइ बहुमत।

Question: What majority is required to pass an amendment bill that has been accepted by a majority of the State Assembly?
Gold Answer: At least two-thirds majority of the total number of then members of both Houses of the Federal Parliament.

Question: प्रदेश सभाको बहुमतबाट स्वीकार गरिएको संशोधन विधेयक पारित गर्न संघीय संसदमा कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: संघीय संसदका दुवै सदनका तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा दुई तिहाइ बहुमत।

Question: Which amendment bills require State Assembly consent before being passed by the Federal Parliament?
Gold Answer: Bills related to State border alteration or matters in Schedule-6.
Gemma Answer: Amendments related to the Exclusive Powers of the Federal Parliament.

Question: कुन संविधान संशोधन विधेयकलाई संघीय संसदबाट पारित गर्नुअघि प्रदेश सभाको सहमति आवश्यक हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: प्रदेशको सीमाना परिवर्तन वा अनुसूची–६ का विषयसँग सम्बन्धित विधेयक।

Question: If a State Assembly rejects an amendment bill, can the Federal Parliament continue processing that bill?
Gold Answer: No, the bill becomes inoperative.

Question: प्रदेश सभाले संशोधन विधेयक अस्वीकार गरेपछि संघीय संसदले सो विधेयकमाथि प्रक्रिया जारी राख्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer: सक्दैन, विधेयक निष्क्रिय हुन्छ।

Question: To whom is a constitutional amendment bill passed under Article 274(8) presented for assent?
Gold Answer: The President.

Question: धारा २७४(८) अनुसार पारित संशोधन विधेयक स्वीकृतिका लागि कससमक्ष पेश गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer: राष्ट्रपति।
Gemma Answer: संसदको दुवै सदन (प्रतिनिधायस र राष्ट्रियसंसद्) मा।

Question: Within how many days must the President give assent to a constitutional amendment bill after receiving it?
Gold Answer: Within fifteen days.

Question: संविधान संशोधन विधेयक प्राप्त भएपछि राष्ट्रपतिले कति दिनभित्र स्वीकृति दिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer: पन्ध्र दिनभित्र।

Question: From which date does the Constitution become amended after an amendment bill receives presidential assent?
Gold Answer: From the date of assent.

Question: संशोधन विधेयकमा राष्ट्रपतिको स्वीकृति पाएपछि संविधान कुन मितिबाट संशोधन भएको मानिन्छ?
Gold Answer: स्वीकृति दिएको मितिबाट।

Question: What is the correct sequence for an amendment bill requiring State Assembly consent?
Gold Answer: Introduction in Federal Parliament → publication within thirty days → State Assembly consent process → two-thirds approval by both Houses → President’s assent.
Gemma Answer: Proposal – State Assembly Consent – Governor – State Legislature – Ratification

Question: प्रदेश सभाको सहमति आवश्यक पर्ने संशोधन विधेयकको सही प्रक्रिया क्रम के हो?
Gold Answer: संघीय संसदमा पेश → तीस दिनभित्र प्रकाशन → प्रदेश सभाको सहमति प्रक्रिया → दुवै सदनको दुई तिहाइ स्वीकृति → राष्ट्रपतिको स्वीकृति।
Gemma Answer:
संशोधन विधेयकको प्रक्रिया:

1.  संशोधन प्रस्ताव दर्ता
2.  सचिवालयको मूल्याङ्कन
3.  प्रतिनिधित्व सभामा प्रस्तुत
4.  प्रतिनिधित्व सभाको मतदान
5.  संविधान सभाको सहमति

Question: If a State Assembly fails to communicate acceptance or rejection within three months, what constitutional option remains available?
Gold Answer: The originating House of the Federal Parliament may proceed with the bill.

Question: प्रदेश सभाले तीन महिनाभित्र स्वीकार वा अस्वीकारको जानकारी नदिएमा संविधानले के विकल्प दिन्छ?
Gold Answer: विधेयक उत्पत्ति भएको संघीय संसदको सदनले प्रक्रिया अगाडि बढाउन सक्छ।

Question: What is the highest voting requirement specified in Article 274 for passing a constitutional amendment bill?
Gold Answer: At least two-thirds majority of the total number of then members of both Houses of the Federal Parliament.

Question: धारा २७४ अनुसार संविधान संशोधन विधेयक पारित गर्न तोकिएको सबैभन्दा उच्च मतदान आवश्यकता के हो?
Gold Answer: संघीय संसदका दुवै सदनका तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा दुई तिहाइ बहुमत।

Question: What majority of the total number of the then members of the Federal Parliament is required to decide that a referendum is necessary on a matter of national importance?
Gold Answer: A two-thirds majority of the total number of the then members of the Federal Parliament is required.

Question: राष्ट्रिय महत्वको विषयमा जनमतसंग्रह आवश्यक छ भनी निर्णय गर्न संघीय संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका सम्पूर्ण सदस्य संख्याको कति बहुमत आवश्यक पर्छ?
Gold Answer: संघीय संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका सम्पूर्ण सदस्य संख्याको दुई तिहाइ बहुमत आवश्यक पर्छ।

Question: On what type of matter may a decision be taken through a referendum under Article 275?
Gold Answer: A matter of national importance, if the Federal Parliament decides by a two-thirds majority that a referendum is necessary.

Question: धारा २७५ बमोजिम कुन प्रकारको विषयमा जनमतसंग्रहमार्फत निर्णय लिन सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer: संघीय संसदले दुई तिहाइ बहुमतबाट आवश्यक ठहर गरेको राष्ट्रिय महत्वको विषयमा।

Question: Who may grant pardons, suspend, commute, or remit sentences under Article 276?
Gold Answer: The President may do so in accordance with law.

Question: धारा २७६ बमोजिम कसले माफी दिन, सजाय स्थगन गर्न, घटाउन वा मिनाहा गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer: राष्ट्रपतिले कानूनबमोजिम त्यस्तो कार्य गर्न सक्छन्।

Question: Can the President grant a pardon for a sentence imposed only by a regular court?
Gold Answer: No. The President may grant pardons, suspend, commute, or remit sentences passed by a court, judicial or quasi-judicial body, or administrative authority or body, in accordance with law.

Question: के राष्ट्रपतिले नियमित अदालतले दिएको सजायमा मात्र माफी दिन सक्छन्?
Gold Answer: होइन। राष्ट्रपतिले अदालत, न्यायिक वा अर्धन्यायिक निकाय वा प्रशासनिक अधिकारी वा निकायबाट भएको सजायलाई कानूनबमोजिम माफी, स्थगन, घटाउन वा मिनाहा गर्न सक्छन्।

Question: Who confers titles, honours, and decorations on behalf of the State?
Gold Answer: The President.

Question: राज्यको तर्फबाट उपाधि, सम्मान र विभूषण कसले प्रदान गर्छ?
Gold Answer: राष्ट्रपति।
Gemma Answer: राज्यको तर्फबाट उपाधि, सम्मान र विभूषण राष्ट्रपति प्रदान गर्छिन्।

Question: May a citizen of Nepal accept a title, honour, or decoration from a foreign government without approval from the Government of Nepal?
Gold Answer: No. Approval from the Government of Nepal is required.

Question: के नेपालका नागरिकले नेपाल सरकारको स्वीकृतिबिना विदेशी सरकारबाट उपाधि, सम्मान वा विभूषण स्वीकार गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer: होइन। नेपाल सरकारको स्वीकृति आवश्यक हुन्छ।

Question: Which level of government has the power to make treaties or agreements under Article 278(1)?
Gold Answer: The Federation.

Question: धारा २७८(१) बमोजिम सन्धि वा सम्झौता गर्ने अधिकार कुन तहको सरकारसँग हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: संघसँग।

Question: What must the Government of Nepal do when making a treaty or agreement concerning a matter falling within the list of State powers?
Gold Answer: It must consult the concerned State.
Gemma Answer: Obtain the consent of the Parliament.

Question: प्रदेशको अधिकार सूचीमा पर्ने विषयमा सन्धि वा सम्झौता गर्दा नेपाल सरकारले के गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer: सम्बन्धित प्रदेशसँग परामर्श गर्नुपर्छ।
Gemma Answer: प्रदेश सरकारको अधिकार सूचीमा पर्ने विषयमा सन्धि वा सम्झौता गर्दा नेपाल सरकारले त्यसको सहमति आवश्यक रहन्छ।

Question: Under what condition may a State Council of Ministers make contractual agreements on financial and industrial matters?
Gold Answer: With the consent of the Government of Nepal.
Gemma Answer: When authorized by an Act of Parliament.

Question: प्रदेश मन्त्रिपरिषद्ले वित्तीय तथा औद्योगिक विषयमा कुन शर्तमा करार सम्झौता गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer: नेपाल सरकारको सहमतिमा।

Question: Which four categories of treaties or agreements require ratification, accession, acceptance, or approval by a two-thirds majority of the total number of the then members of both Houses of the Federal Parliament?
Gold Answer: Peace and friendship; defence and strategic alliance; boundaries of Nepal; and natural resources and the distribution of their uses.
Gemma Answer:
1.  Treaties relating to defense
2.  Treaties relating to foreign trade
3.  Treaties relating to membership in international organizations
4.  Treaties relating to the establishment of missions abroad

Question: संघीय संसदका दुवै सदनका तत्काल कायम रहेका सम्पूर्ण सदस्य संख्याको दुई तिहाइ बहुमतबाट अनुमोदन, सम्मिलन, स्वीकृति वा समर्थन आवश्यक पर्ने सन्धि वा सम्झौताका चार विषय कुन-कुन हुन्?
Gold Answer: शान्ति तथा मैत्री; रक्षा तथा सामरिक गठबन्धन; नेपालको सीमाना; तथा प्राकृतिक स्रोत र त्यसको उपयोगको बाँडफाँड।
Gemma Answer:
*   संवैधानिक संशोधन
*   नागरिकशास्त्र सम्बन्धी सम्झौता
*   व्यापार सम्बन्धी सम्झौता
*   सुरक्षा सम्बन्धी सम्झौता

Question: Under what exception may a treaty concerning peace and friendship or natural resources be approved by a simple majority of members present in a meeting of the House of Representatives?
Gold Answer: If the treaty or agreement is of an ordinary nature and does not affect the nation extensively, seriously, or in the long term.
Gemma Answer: A treaty concerning peace and friendship or natural resources may be approved by a simple majority if it is approved by a two-thirds majority in the Senate.

Question: शान्ति तथा मैत्री वा प्राकृतिक स्रोतसम्बन्धी सन्धि वा सम्झौता कुन अवस्थामा प्रतिनिधि सभाको बैठकमा उपस्थित सदस्यहरूको साधारण बहुमतबाट अनुमोदन गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer: त्यस्तो सन्धि वा सम्झौता साधारण प्रकृतिको भई राष्ट्रलाई व्यापक, गम्भीर वा दीर्घकालीन रूपमा असर नगर्ने भएमा।
Gemma Answer: शान्ति तथा मैत्री वा प्राकृतिक स्रोत सम् सन्धि वा सम्झौता।

Question: What is the constitutional consequence if a treaty or agreement is not ratified, acceded to, accepted, or approved according to Article 279?
Gold Answer: After the commencement of the Constitution, the treaty or agreement does not apply to Nepal or the Government of Nepal. Additionally, no treaty or agreement may be concluded in a manner detrimental to Nepal's territorial integrity.

Question: धारा २७९ बमोजिम कुनै सन्धि वा सम्झौता अनुमोदन, सम्मिलन, स्वीकृति वा समर्थन नगरिएमा त्यसको संवैधानिक परिणाम के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: संविधान प्रारम्भ भएपछि त्यस्तो सन्धि वा सम्झौता नेपाल वा नेपाल सरकारमा लागू हुँदैन। साथै नेपालको क्षेत्रीय अखण्डतामा प्रतिकूल हुने गरी कुनै सन्धि वा सम्झौता गर्न सकिँदैन।

Question: If both the offices of the President and Vice-President become vacant, who shall discharge the functions of the President until a new President or Vice-President is elected and assumes office?
Gold Answer: The Speaker of the House of Representatives.

Question: राष्ट्रपति र उपराष्ट्रपति दुवै पद रिक्त भएमा नयाँ राष्ट्रपति वा उपराष्ट्रपति निर्वाचित भई पदभार ग्रहण नगरेसम्म राष्ट्रपतिको कार्य कसले सम्पादन गर्छ?
Gold Answer: प्रतिनिधि सभाका सभामुखले।

Question: How frequently must the Government of Nepal appraise and review the implementation and impacts of the special rights of women and the Dalit community?
Gold Answer: Every ten years, concurrently with the national census.

Question: महिला र दलित समुदायका विशेष अधिकारको कार्यान्वयन र त्यसको प्रभावको मूल्याङ्कन तथा समीक्षा कति अवधिमा गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer: प्रत्येक दस वर्षमा हुने राष्ट्रिय जनगणनासँगै।

Question: On what principle may the President appoint Nepalese ambassadors and special emissaries?
Gold Answer: The principle of inclusion.

Question: राष्ट्रपतिले नेपाली राजदूत तथा विशेष दूतहरू कुन सिद्धान्तका आधारमा नियुक्त गर्न सक्छन्?
Gold Answer: समावेशी सिद्धान्तका आधारमा।
Gemma Answer: पद, योग्यता, अनुभव र सेवाको आवश्यकता।

Question: Who receives letters of credentials from foreign ambassadors and diplomatic representatives?
Gold Answer: The President.

Question: विदेशी राजदूत तथा कूटनीतिक प्रतिनिधिहरूको ओहोदाको प्रमाणपत्र कसले ग्रहण गर्छ?
Gold Answer: राष्ट्रपतिले।

Question: According to Article 283, what principle must be followed when making appointments to Constitutional Organs and Bodies?
Gold Answer: The inclusive principle.

Question: धारा २८३ बमोजिम संवैधानिक अंग तथा निकायमा नियुक्ति गर्दा कुन सिद्धान्तको पालना गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer: समावेशी सिद्धान्त।

Question: Who serves as the Chairperson of the Constitutional Council?
Gold Answer: The Prime Minister.

Question: संवैधानिक परिषद्को अध्यक्ष को हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: प्रधानमन्त्री।

Question: Which of the following is NOT a regular member of the Constitutional Council under Article 284(1)? A. Chief Justice B. Speaker of the House of Representatives C. Minister for Law and Justice D. Chairperson of the National Assembly
Gold Answer: The Minister for Law and Justice.
Gemma Answer: B. Speaker of the House of Representatives

Question: धारा २८४(१) बमोजिम निम्नमध्ये को संवैधानिक परिषद्को नियमित सदस्य होइन? क. प्रधानन्यायाधीश ख. प्रतिनिधि सभाका सभामुख ग. कानून तथा न्यायमन्त्री घ. राष्ट्रिय सभाका अध्यक्ष
Gold Answer: कानून तथा न्यायमन्त्री।

Question: How far in advance must the Constitutional Council generally make a recommendation for the appointment of a Chief Justice or a chief or official of a Constitutional Body before the office becomes vacant?
Gold Answer: At least one month before the office becomes vacant.

Question: प्रधानन्यायाधीश वा संवैधानिक निकायका प्रमुख वा पदाधिकारीको पद रिक्त हुनुभन्दा सामान्यतया कति अगाडि संवैधानिक परिषद्ले नियुक्तिको सिफारिस गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer: पद रिक्त हुनुभन्दा कम्तीमा एक महिना अगाडि।

Question: On what basis must positions in the Federal civil service and other Federal government services be filled?
Gold Answer: Through competitive examinations based on open and proportional inclusive principles.

Question: संघीय निजामती सेवा तथा अन्य संघीय सरकारी सेवाका पदहरू कुन आधारमा पूर्ति गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer: खुला तथा समानुपातिक समावेशी सिद्धान्तका आधारमा प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक परीक्षामार्फत।

Question: Which of the following is NOT listed as a member of the Election Constituency Delimitation Commission? A. A retired Judge of the Supreme Court B. A geographer C. A sociologist or demographer D. The Chief Election Commissioner
Gold Answer: The Chief Election Commissioner.

Question: निम्नमध्ये को निर्वाचन क्षेत्र निर्धारण आयोगको सदस्यका रूपमा उल्लेख गरिएको छैन? क. सर्वोच्च अदालतका सेवानिवृत्त न्यायाधीश ख. भूगोलविद् ग. समाजशास्त्री वा जनसांख्यिकीविद् घ. प्रमुख निर्वाचन आयुक्त
Gold Answer: प्रमुख निर्वाचन आयुक्त।

Question: What factors must the Election Constituency Delimitation Commission consider when determining election constituencies, in addition to population and geography?
Gold Answer: It must consider, among other things, population density, geographical specificity, administrative and transportation convenience, and the community and cultural aspects of the constituencies.
Gemma Answer: Historical boundaries, linguistic considerations, social and economic factors, and representation of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.

Question: निर्वाचन क्षेत्र निर्धारण गर्दा जनसंख्या र भूगोलका अतिरिक्त निर्वाचन क्षेत्र निर्धारण आयोगले कुन-कुन पक्षलाई ध्यान दिनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer: जनघनत्व, भौगोलिक विशिष्टता, प्रशासनिक तथा यातायात सुविधा र निर्वाचन क्षेत्रका सामुदायिक तथा सांस्कृतिक पक्षलगायतका विषयलाई ध्यान दिनुपर्छ।
Gemma Answer: साँस्कृतिक विविधता, भाषिक विविधता, सामाजिक समानता, र जनमत प्रतिनिधित्व।

Question: State three important constitutional requirements relating to the Language Commission's composition, term, and qualifications.
Gold Answer: The Commission must have one Chairperson and the required number of members; the term of the Chairperson and members is six years and they cannot be reappointed; and appointees must have a relevant master's degree, at least twenty years of experience in the study, teaching, and research of Nepal's languages, be at least forty-five years old, and possess high moral character.
Gemma Answer:
*   Independent Composition
*   Fixed Term
*   Qualifications in Language Expertise

Question: भाषा आयोगको गठन, पदावधि र योग्यता सम्बन्धी तीनवटा महत्वपूर्ण संवैधानिक प्रावधान उल्लेख गर्नुहोस्।
Gold Answer: आयोगमा एक जना अध्यक्ष र आवश्यक संख्यामा सदस्य हुन्छन्; अध्यक्ष तथा सदस्यको पदावधि छ वर्षको हुन्छ र पुनः नियुक्ति हुन सक्दैन; तथा नियुक्त व्यक्तिसँग सम्बन्धित विषयमा स्नातकोत्तर उपाधि, नेपालको विभिन्न भाषाको अध्ययन, अध्यापन तथा अनुसन्धानमा कम्तीमा बीस वर्षको अनुभव, कम्तीमा पैंतालीस वर्ष उमेर र उच्च नैतिक चरित्र हुनुपर्छ।
Gemma Answer:
*   **गठन:** राष्ट्रपति समिक्षा परिषद् गठन गरेको आयोगको सिफारिस स्वीकृतिको मितिले ३० दिनभित्र आयोग गठन गर्नुपर्नेछ।
*   **पदावधि:** आयोगको पदावधि ३ देखि ५ वर्षसम्म हुनेछ।
*   **योग्यता:** आयोगका सदस्यहरूलाई भाषा विज्ञान, कानुन, समाजशास्त्र, मानविकी, वा सो सँगसम्बन्धित विषयमा विशेषज्ञता वा अनुभव भएको हुनुपर्नेछ।

Question: Where is the capital of Nepal situated?
Gold Answer: Kathmandu.

Question: नेपालको राजधानी कहाँ अवस्थित छ?
Gold Answer: काठमाडौंमा।

Question: By what majority is the capital of a State decided by the concerned State Assembly?
Gold Answer: A two-thirds majority of the total number of the then members of the concerned State Assembly.

Question: सम्बन्धित प्रदेश सभाले प्रदेशको राजधानी कुन बहुमतबाट निर्धारण गर्छ?
Gold Answer: सम्बन्धित प्रदेश सभाका तत्काल कायम रहेका सम्पूर्ण सदस्य संख्याको दुई तिहाइ बहुमतबाट।

Question: Which type of citizenship must a person possess to be eligible for election, nomination, or appointment as President, Vice-President, Prime Minister, Chief Justice, Speaker of the House of Representatives, Chief of State, Chief Minister, Speaker of a State Assembly, or chief of a security body?
Gold Answer: Citizenship of Nepal by descent.
Gemma Answer: Citizenship by birth in the country in question.

Question: राष्ट्रपति, उपराष्ट्रपति, प्रधानमन्त्री, प्रधानन्यायाधीश, प्रतिनिधि सभाका सभामुख, प्रदेश प्रमुख, मुख्यमन्त्री, प्रदेश सभाका सभामुख वा सुरक्षा निकायको प्रमुख पदमा निर्वाचित, मनोनीत वा नियुक्त हुन व्यक्तिसँग कस्तो नागरिकता हुनुपर्छ?
Gold Answer: वंशजको आधारमा प्राप्त नेपालको नागरिकता।

Question: Under what additional residence conditions may a person with naturalized citizenship or citizenship by birth be qualified for an office of a Constitutional Body other than the offices listed in Article 289(1)?
Gold Answer: A naturalized citizen must have resided in Nepal for at least ten years, while a person who obtained citizenship by birth must have resided in Nepal for at least five years.
Gemma Answer: Residence in the country for at least seven years prior to the election.

Question: धारा २८९(१) मा उल्लिखित बाहेक अन्य संवैधानिक निकायको पदमा प्राकृतिकीकृत वा जन्मको आधारमा नागरिकता प्राप्त व्यक्तिले कुन अतिरिक्त बसोबाससम्बन्धी शर्त पूरा गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer: प्राकृतिकीकृत नागरिकले कम्तीमा दस वर्ष र जन्मको आधारमा नागरिकता प्राप्त व्यक्तिले कम्तीमा पाँच वर्ष नेपालमा बसोबास गरेको हुनुपर्छ।

Question: What must the Federal Parliament ensure when making laws concerning the rights of trusts and farmers enjoying possessory rights over trust lands?
Gold Answer: The laws must not be prejudicial to the basic norms of the trusts.

Question: गुठीको अधिकार तथा गुठी जग्गामा भोगाधिकार भएका किसानका अधिकारसम्बन्धी कानून बनाउँदा संघीय संसदले के सुनिश्चित गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer: त्यस्ता कानून गुठीका आधारभूत मान्यतामा प्रतिकूल नहुने कुरा सुनिश्चित गर्नुपर्छ।
Gemma Answer: गुठीको अधिकार र गुठी जग्गामा भोगाधिकार भएका किसानका अधिकार सुरक्षित रहन् र संघीय सरकारले त्यसको कार्यान्वयन सुनिश्चित गरोस्।

Question: Can a Nepali citizen holding a foreign permanent residence permit be elected, nominated, or appointed to an office under the Constitution?
Gold Answer: No. However, a person who has renounced the permit may become eligible after at least three months have expired from the date of renunciation.

Question: विदेशी स्थायी आवासीय अनुमति लिएको नेपाली नागरिक संविधानबमोजिम निर्वाचित, मनोनीत वा नियुक्त हुने पदमा योग्य हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: हुँदैन। तर त्यस्तो अनुमति त्यागेको व्यक्तिले त्यागेको मितिले कम्तीमा तीन महिना पूरा भएपछि योग्य हुन सक्छ।

Question: For which categories of appointments are parliamentary hearings conducted under Article 292?
Gold Answer: Appointments to the offices of the Chief Justice and Supreme Court Judges, members of the Judicial Council, chiefs and members of Constitutional Bodies appointed on the recommendation of the Constitutional Council, and ambassadors.

Question: धारा २९२ बमोजिम कुन-कुन नियुक्तिका लागि संसदीय सुनुवाइ गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer: प्रधानन्यायाधीश तथा सर्वोच्च अदालतका न्यायाधीश, न्याय परिषद्का सदस्य, संवैधानिक परिषद्को सिफारिसमा नियुक्त हुने संवैधानिक निकायका प्रमुख तथा सदस्य र राजदूतको नियुक्तिमा।
Gemma Answer: संसदीय सुनुवाइमा धारा २९२ बमोजिम उच्च तहका कर्मचारीहरू नियुक्तिका लागि सुनुवाइ गरिन्छ।

Question: How many members are in the joint committee formed for the purpose of parliamentary hearings?
Gold Answer: Fifteen members from both Houses of the Federal Parliament.

Question: संसदीय सुनुवाइका लागि गठन हुने संयुक्त समितिमा कति सदस्य हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer: संघीय संसदका दुवै सदनका गरी पन्ध्र जना सदस्य।

Question: What professional restriction applies to members of the parliamentary hearing joint committee during that term of the Federal Parliament?
Gold Answer: They may not practice law in the Supreme Court.
Gemma Answer: Members must not be involved in the management or control of any business.

Question: संघीय संसदको उक्त कार्यकालमा संसदीय सुनुवाइ संयुक्त समितिका सदस्यहरूलाई कुन पेशागत प्रतिबन्ध लागू हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: उनीहरूले सर्वोच्च अदालतमा कानून व्यवसाय गर्न पाउँदैनन्।

Question: Which Constitutional Body is specifically excluded from monitoring and evaluation by committees of the House of Representatives under Article 293?
Gold Answer: The National Human Rights Commission.

Question: धारा २९३ बमोजिम प्रतिनिधि सभाका समितिहरूले संवैधानिक निकायहरूको कामकारबाही अनुगमन तथा मूल्याङ्कन गर्दा कुन संवैधानिक निकायलाई विशेष रूपमा अपवाद गरिएको छ?
Gold Answer: राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोग।

Question: What is the reporting process for Constitutional Bodies under Article 294?
Gold Answer: Each Constitutional Body submits an annual report of its functioning to the President, who causes it to be laid before the Federal Parliament through the Prime Minister. A Constitutional Body may also prepare a separate report on its functioning in each State and submit it to the Chief of State.
Gemma Answer: The reporting process for Constitutional Bodies under Article 294 involves submitting a written report to the President, who then forwards it to the Parliament.

Question: धारा २९४ बमोजिम संवैधानिक निकायहरूको वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन पेश गर्ने प्रक्रिया के हो?
Gold Answer: प्रत्येक संवैधानिक निकायले आफ्नो कामकारबाहीको वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन राष्ट्रपतिसमक्ष पेश गर्छ र राष्ट्रपतिले प्रधानमन्त्रीमार्फत संघीय संसदसमक्ष पेश गराउँछन्। संवैधानिक निकायले प्रत्येक प्रदेशमा आफ्नो कामकारबाहीसम्बन्धी छुट्टै प्रतिवेदन तयार गरी प्रदेश प्रमुखसमक्ष पेश गर्न पनि सक्छ।
Gemma Answer:
धारा २९४ बमोजिम संवैधानिक निकायहरूको वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन पेश गर्ने प्रक्रिया निम्न छ:

1.  नेटिसनले प्रतिवेदन तयार पार्नु पर्छ।
2.  तयार भएको प्रतिवेदन संवहन कार्यालयमा पेस्नु पर्छ।

Question: What may the Government of Nepal constitute under Article 295(1) to make suggestions on matters relating to the boundaries of States?
Gold Answer: The Government of Nepal may constitute a Federal Commission.

Question: धारा २९५(१) बमोजिम प्रदेशको सीमासम्बन्धी विषयमा सुझाव दिन नेपाल सरकारले के गठन गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer: नेपाल सरकारले संघीय आयोग गठन गर्न सक्छ।

Question: By what majority must the names of the States be decided by the concerned State Assemblies under Article 295(2)?
Gold Answer: A two-thirds majority of the total number of members of the concerned State Assembly is required.

Question: धारा २९५(२) बमोजिम सम्बन्धित प्रदेश सभाले प्रदेशको नाम निर्धारण गर्दा कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक पर्छ?
Gold Answer: सम्बन्धित प्रदेश सभाका सम्पूर्ण सदस्य संख्याको दुई तिहाइ बहुमत आवश्यक पर्छ।

Question: What commission was required to be constituted to determine the number and boundaries of Village Bodies, Municipalities, and Special, Protected, or Autonomous Regions?
Gold Answer: The Government of Nepal was required to constitute a commission for determining their number and boundaries.
Gemma Answer: A commission of three or more members.

Question: गाउँ निकाय, नगरपालिका तथा विशेष, संरक्षित वा स्वायत्त क्षेत्रको संख्या र सीमाना निर्धारण गर्न कुन आयोग गठन गर्नुपर्ने व्यवस्था थियो?
Gold Answer: नेपाल सरकारले तिनको संख्या र सीमाना निर्धारण गर्न आयोग गठन गर्नुपर्ने व्यवस्था थियो।

Question: Within what period after the commencement of the Constitution was the commission under Article 295(3) required to be constituted, and what was its term?
Gold Answer: It had to be constituted within six months of the commencement of the Constitution, and its term was one year.
Gemma Answer: Within six months of the Constitution’s commencement, with a term of three years.

Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ भएको कति समयभित्र धारा २९५(३) बमोजिमको आयोग गठन गर्नुपर्ने थियो र यसको कार्यकाल कति थियो?
Gold Answer: संविधान प्रारम्भ भएको छ महिनाभित्र आयोग गठन गर्नुपर्ने र यसको कार्यकाल एक वर्षको हुने थियो।

Question: What happened to the Constituent Assembly existing at the commencement of the Constitution?
Gold Answer: It was automatically converted into the Legislature-Parliament.

Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदाका बखत विद्यमान संविधान सभाको के भयो?
Gold Answer: संविधान सभा स्वतः व्यवस्थापिका–संसदमा परिणत भयो।

Question: What happened to Bills under consideration in the Legislature-Parliament when the Constitution commenced?
Gold Answer: They were automatically transferred to the Legislature-Parliament formed under Article 296(1).

Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदा व्यवस्थापिका–संसदमा विचाराधीन विधेयकहरूको के भयो?
Gold Answer: ती विधेयकहरू धारा २९६(१) बमोजिमको व्यवस्थापिका–संसदमा स्वतः हस्तान्तरण भए।

Question: Until the election to the House of Representatives was held under the Constitution, what functions did the transitional Legislature-Parliament perform?
Gold Answer: It performed the business required to be performed by the Federal Parliament under the Constitution.
Gemma Answer: It performed the functions of the legislature until the new House was formed.

Question: संविधानबमोजिम प्रतिनिधि सभाको निर्वाचन नभएसम्म संक्रमणकालीन व्यवस्थापिका–संसदले कुन कार्य सम्पादन गर्थ्यो?
Gold Answer: यसले संविधानबमोजिम संघीय संसदले गर्नुपर्ने कार्य सम्पादन गर्थ्यो।

Question: Until a State Assembly was formed, who exercised the legislative power relating to matters listed in Schedule 6?
Gold Answer: The Legislature-Parliament exercised that legislative power.

Question: प्रदेश सभा गठन नभएसम्म अनुसूची–६ मा उल्लिखित विषयसम्बन्धी प्रदेशको विधायिकी अधिकार कसले प्रयोग गर्थ्यो?
Gold Answer: व्यवस्थापिका–संसदले उक्त विधायिकी अधिकार प्रयोग गर्थ्यो।

Question: Until when did the President and Vice-President existing at the commencement of the Constitution continue to hold office?
Gold Answer: They continued to hold office until another President and Vice-President were elected in accordance with Article 297.

Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदाका बखत पदमा रहेका राष्ट्रपति र उपराष्ट्रपति कहिलेसम्म पदमा कायम रहने व्यवस्था थियो?
Gold Answer: धारा २९७ बमोजिम अर्को राष्ट्रपति र उपराष्ट्रपति निर्वाचित नभएसम्म उनीहरू पदमा कायम रहने व्यवस्था थियो।

Question: If the Legislature-Parliament failed to reach a political understanding for electing the President and Vice-President, how were they to be elected?
Gold Answer: They were to be elected by a majority of all the then members of the Legislature-Parliament.
Gemma Answer: By a majority vote of two-thirds of the total number of Members of the Legislature-Parliament.

Question: राष्ट्रपति र उपराष्ट्रपति निर्वाचित गर्न व्यवस्थापिका–संसदमा राजनीतिक सहमति हुन नसकेमा उनीहरू कसरी निर्वाचित हुने थिए?
Gold Answer: व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका सम्पूर्ण सदस्यको बहुमतबाट निर्वाचित हुने थिए।

Question: What minimum proportion of the total number of then members of the Legislature-Parliament could move an impeachment motion against the transitional President or Vice-President for serious violation of the Constitution and law?
Gold Answer: At least one-fourth of the total number of the then members of the Legislature-Parliament.

Question: संविधान र कानूनको गम्भीर उल्लङ्घन गरेको आधारमा संक्रमणकालीन राष्ट्रपति वा उपराष्ट्रपतिविरुद्ध महाभियोग प्रस्ताव ल्याउन व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा कति भाग आवश्यक पर्थ्यो?
Gold Answer: व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा एक चौथाइ।

Question: What majority was required for an impeachment motion against the transitional President or Vice-President to remove them from office?
Gold Answer: A two-thirds majority of the total number of the then members of the Legislature-Parliament was required.
Gemma Answer: A two-thirds majority vote in the National Assembly.

Question: संक्रमणकालीन राष्ट्रपति वा उपराष्ट्रपतिलाई पदबाट हटाउन महाभियोग प्रस्ताव पारित गर्न कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक पर्थ्यो?
Gold Answer: व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल सदस्य संख्याको दुई तिहाइ बहुमत आवश्यक पर्थ्यो।

Question: What happened to the Council of Ministers existing at the commencement of the Constitution?
Gold Answer: It continued to exist until the Council of Ministers under Article 298(2) was formed.
Gemma Answer: It was abolished by the Constitution (Amendment) Act, 1976.

Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदाका बखत विद्यमान मन्त्रिपरिषद्को के भयो?
Gold Answer: धारा २९८(२) बमोजिमको मन्त्रिपरिषद् गठन नभएसम्म विद्यमान मन्त्रिपरिषद् कायम रह्यो।

Question: Within what period was the Prime Minister required to be elected after the commencement of the Constitution when the Legislature-Parliament was not in recess?
Gold Answer: The Prime Minister had to be elected no later than seven days after the commencement of the Constitution.

Question: व्यवस्थापिका–संसद अधिवेशनमा नरहेको अवस्थामा संविधान प्रारम्भ भएपछि कति समयभित्र प्रधानमन्त्री निर्वाचित गर्नुपर्ने थियो?
Gold Answer: संविधान प्रारम्भ भएको सात दिनभित्र प्रधानमन्त्री निर्वाचित गर्नुपर्ने थियो।

Question: If political understanding could not be reached for electing the Prime Minister, how was the Prime Minister elected?
Gold Answer: The Prime Minister was elected by a majority of all the then members of the Legislature-Parliament.

Question: प्रधानमन्त्री निर्वाचित गर्न राजनीतिक सहमति हुन नसकेमा प्रधानमन्त्री कसरी निर्वाचित हुने व्यवस्था थियो?
Gold Answer: व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका सम्पूर्ण सदस्यको बहुमतबाट प्रधानमन्त्री निर्वाचित हुने व्यवस्था थियो।
Gemma Answer: तत्कालिन राजाले नियुक्त गर्ने व्यवस्था थियो।

Question: What minimum composition of the Council of Ministers was expressly provided under Article 298?
Gold Answer: It consisted of the Prime Minister, a Deputy Prime Minister, and other Ministers as required.

Question: धारा २९८ बमोजिम गठन हुने मन्त्रिपरिषद्को न्यूनतम संरचनामा को–को रहने व्यवस्था थियो?
Gold Answer: प्रधानमन्त्री, एक उपप्रधानमन्त्री तथा आवश्यकताअनुसार अन्य मन्त्रीहरू रहने व्यवस्था थियो।

Question: From whom did the Prime Minister appoint Ministers under the transitional arrangement?
Gold Answer: Ministers were appointed from among the members of the Legislature-Parliament on the recommendation of the concerned party.
Gemma Answer: The Cabinet appointed by the Prime Minister during the transitional arrangement consisted of members from the opposition parties.

Question: संक्रमणकालीन व्यवस्थाअन्तर्गत प्रधानमन्त्रीले मन्त्रीहरू कसबाट नियुक्त गर्थे?
Gold Answer: सम्बन्धित दलको सिफारिसमा व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका सदस्यहरूमध्येबाट मन्त्री नियुक्त गरिन्थ्यो।

Question: What minimum proportion of the then members of the Legislature-Parliament could table a written motion of no-confidence against the transitional Prime Minister?
Gold Answer: At least one-fourth of the total number of the then members of the Legislature-Parliament.

Question: संक्रमणकालीन प्रधानमन्त्रीविरुद्ध लिखित अविश्वास प्रस्ताव ल्याउन व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा कति भाग आवश्यक पर्थ्यो?
Gold Answer: व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका तत्काल कायम रहेका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा एक चौथाइ।

Question: Within what period were the Speaker and Deputy Speaker required to be elected after the commencement of the Constitution when the Legislature-Parliament was not in recess?
Gold Answer: They had to be elected no later than twenty days after the commencement of the Constitution.

Question: व्यवस्थापिका–संसद अधिवेशनमा नरहेको अवस्थामा संविधान प्रारम्भ भएपछि सभामुख र उपसभामुख कति समयभित्र निर्वाचित गर्नुपर्ने थियो?
Gold Answer: संविधान प्रारम्भ भएको बीस दिनभित्र सभामुख र उपसभामुख निर्वाचित गर्नुपर्ने थियो।

Question: What requirement applied to the political-party representation of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker elected under Article 299?
Gold Answer: They had to be members representing different political parties in the Legislature-Parliament.
Gemma Answer: The Speaker and Deputy Speaker must be elected from among members of different political parties.

Question: धारा २९९ बमोजिम निर्वाचित सभामुख र उपसभामुखको राजनीतिक दलसम्बन्धी प्रतिनिधित्वमा के व्यवस्था थियो?
Gold Answer: उनीहरू व्यवस्थापिका–संसदमा प्रतिनिधित्व गर्ने फरक–फरक राजनीतिक दलका सदस्य हुनुपर्ने थियो।
Gemma Answer: धारा २९९ बमोजिम निर्वाचित सभामुख र उपसभामुख कुनै पनि राजनीतिक दलको सदस्यता राख्न नहुने थियो।

Question: How were the Speaker and Deputy Speaker required to perform their functions under Article 299?
Gold Answer: They had to perform their functions as neutral persons without standing for or against any political party.
Gemma Answer: Article 299 states that the Speaker and Deputy Speaker must perform their functions independently and impartially.

Question: धारा २९९ बमोजिम सभामुख र उपसभामुखले आफ्नो कार्य कसरी सम्पादन गर्नुपर्ने थियो?
Gold Answer: कुनै पनि राजनीतिक दलको पक्ष वा विपक्षमा नउभिई तटस्थ व्यक्तिको रूपमा कार्य सम्पादन गर्नुपर्ने थियो।
Gemma Answer: धारा २९९ बमोजिम सभामुख र उपसभामुखले संविधान र नियमावली बमोजिम आफ्नो कार्य सम्पादन गर्ने थिए।

Question: What majority was required for a resolution declaring that the conduct of the Speaker or Deputy Speaker was incompatible with the office?
Gold Answer: A majority of at least two-thirds of the total number of members of the Legislature-Parliament was required.

Question: सभामुख वा उपसभामुखको आचरण निजको पदसँग अनुकूल नभएको घोषणा गर्ने प्रस्ताव पारित गर्न कस्तो बहुमत आवश्यक पर्थ्यो?
Gold Answer: व्यवस्थापिका–संसदका कुल सदस्य संख्याको कम्तीमा दुई तिहाइ बहुमत आवश्यक पर्थ्यो।

Question: Which existing courts continued to exist until the judicial structure provided for in the Constitution was established?
Gold Answer: The Supreme Court, Constituent Assembly Court, Appellate Courts, and District Courts continued to exist.

Question: संविधानमा व्यवस्था गरिएको न्यायपालिकाको संरचना स्थापना नभएसम्म कुन–कुन विद्यमान अदालतहरू कायम रहने व्यवस्था थियो?
Gold Answer: सर्वोच्च अदालत, संविधान सभा अदालत, पुनरावेदन अदालत र जिल्ला अदालतहरू कायम रहने व्यवस्था थियो।
Gemma Answer: विद्यमान सर्वोच्च न्यायालय र बहालवाला महान्gerichtहरू।

Question: What happened to cases pending in the Appellate Courts after the establishment of the High Courts?
Gold Answer: They were transferred to the High Courts specified by the Government of Nepal in consultation with the Judicial Council.
Gemma Answer: The Appellate Courts were abolished, and their cases were transferred to the High Courts.

Question: उच्च अदालत स्थापना भएपछि पुनरावेदन अदालतमा विचाराधीन मुद्दाहरूको के हुने व्यवस्था थियो?
Gold Answer: न्याय परिषद्सँग परामर्श गरी नेपाल सरकारले तोकेका उच्च अदालतहरूमा ती मुद्दाहरू हस्तान्तरण गरिने व्यवस्था थियो।
Gemma Answer: उच्च अदालत स्थापना भएपछि पुनरावेदन अदालतमा विचाराधीन मुद्दाहरू उच्च अदालतमा नै विचाराधीन रहेका थिए।

Question: How are Constitutional Bodies existing at the commencement of the Constitution treated under Article 301?
Gold Answer: They are deemed to have been formed under the Constitution.

Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदा विद्यमान संवैधानिक निकायहरूलाई धारा ३०१ अन्तर्गत कसरी मानिन्छ?
Gold Answer: संविधानअन्तर्गत गठन भएको मानिन्छ।
Gemma Answer: विद्यमान संवैधानिक निकायहरू धारा ३०१ अन्तर्गत ‘सरकारी निकाय’ मानिन्छन्।

Question: What happens to matters under consideration by existing Constitutional Bodies when the Constitution commences?
Gold Answer: They may continue to be settled subject to the Constitution.

Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदा विद्यमान संवैधानिक निकायहरूमा विचाराधीन विषयहरूको के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: संविधानको अधीनमा रही तिनको निरूपण जारी रहन सक्छ।

Question: How are chiefs and officials of Constitutional Bodies holding office at the commencement of the Constitution treated?
Gold Answer: They are deemed to have been appointed under the Constitution.
Gemma Answer: They continued to hold office until a new election or appointment was made.

Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदा पदमा रहेका संवैधानिक निकायका प्रमुख तथा पदाधिकारीहरूलाई कसरी मानिन्छ?
Gold Answer: संविधानअन्तर्गत नियुक्त भएको मानिन्छ।
Gemma Answer: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदा पदमा रहेका संवैधानिक निकायका प्रमुख तथा पदाधिकारीहरूलाई ‘अधिपतिको सल्लाहकार’ मानिन्थ्यो।

Question: Under what conditions may existing chiefs and officials of Constitutional Bodies continue in office?
Gold Answer: They continue subject to the conditions of service applicable at the time of their appointment.
Gemma Answer: Unless removed by impeachment, censure, or voluntary resignation.

Question: विद्यमान संवैधानिक निकायका प्रमुख तथा पदाधिकारीहरू कुन शर्तमा पदमा कायम रहन सक्छन्?
Gold Answer: नियुक्तिको समयमा लागू रहेका सेवाका शर्तहरूको अधीनमा रही।

Question: What special provision applies to officials of the Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority and the Public Service Commission who exceed the number specified in the Constitution?
Gold Answer: They may continue to hold office subject to the conditions of service applicable at the time of their appointment.

Question: संविधानमा तोकिएको संख्याभन्दा बढी रहेका अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोग र लोक सेवा आयोगका पदाधिकारीसम्बन्धी विशेष व्यवस्था के हो?
Gold Answer: उनीहरू नियुक्तिको समयमा लागू रहेका सेवाका शर्तहरूको अधीनमा रही पदमा कायम रहन सक्छन्।

Question: Who is responsible for making necessary provisions for the delivery of services at the State and Local levels?
Gold Answer: The Government of Nepal.

Question: प्रदेश र स्थानीय तहमा सेवा प्रवाहका लागि आवश्यक व्यवस्था गर्ने जिम्मेवारी कसको हो?
Gold Answer: नेपाल सरकारको।

Question: How may the Government of Nepal arrange for the delivery of services at the State and Local levels during the transition?
Gold Answer: By adjusting employees serving in government services at the commencement of the Constitution among the Federal, State and Local levels in accordance with law.
Gemma Answer: Through provincial and municipal level governance structures, incorporating existing local government institutions and establishing new ones, alongside capacity building and resource allocation.

Question: संक्रमणकालमा प्रदेश र स्थानीय तहमा सेवा प्रवाहको व्यवस्था नेपाल सरकारले कसरी गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदाका सरकारी सेवामा कार्यरत कर्मचारीहरूलाई कानूनबमोजिम संघ, प्रदेश र स्थानीय तहमा समायोजन गरेर।
Gemma Answer: संक्रमणकालमा प्रदेश र स्थानीय तहमा सेवा प्रवाहको व्यवस्था गर्न नेपाल सरकारले तालमेल कायम गरी एकीकृत योजना बनाउनु, समन्वय स्थापित गर्नु र सेवा प्रवाहका लागि आवश्यक बजेट विनियोजन गर्नु पर्दछ।

Question: How long do the Local Bodies existing at the commencement of the Constitution continue to exist?
Gold Answer: Until the number and areas of the Local level are determined in accordance with the Constitution.
Gemma Answer: Until their dissolution as provided for in the Constitution.

Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदा विद्यमान स्थानीय निकायहरू कति समयसम्म कायम रहन्छन्?
Gold Answer: संविधानबमोजिम स्थानीय तहको संख्या र क्षेत्र निर्धारण नभएसम्म।

Question: How are elections to officials of the existing Local Bodies conducted during the transitional period?
Gold Answer: In accordance with law.
Gemma Answer: Elections are conducted as per the existing laws, with the President or Governor exercising powers to appoint officials if required.

Question: संक्रमणकालमा विद्यमान स्थानीय निकायका पदाधिकारीहरूको निर्वाचन कसरी गरिन्छ?
Gold Answer: कानूनबमोजिम।
Gemma Answer: स्थानीय तहको निर्वाचन प्रदेशको अख्तियार समितिले गरिन्छ।

Question: Until when do officials elected to the existing Local Bodies continue to hold office?
Gold Answer: Until elections to the Local level are held in accordance with the Constitution.
Gemma Answer: Until the end of the term for which they were elected.

Question: विद्यमान स्थानीय निकायमा निर्वाचित पदाधिकारीहरू कहिलेसम्म पदमा कायम रहन्छन्?
Gold Answer: संविधानबमोजिम स्थानीय तहको निर्वाचन नभएसम्म।

Question: What is the general rule regarding Nepalese laws in force when the Constitution commences?
Gold Answer: They continue to remain in force until repealed or amended.
Gemma Answer: Existing laws in force at the time of the commencement of the Constitution remained in effect.

Question: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदा प्रचलित नेपालका कानूनहरूबारे सामान्य व्यवस्था के हो?
Gold Answer: खारेज वा संशोधन नभएसम्म ती कानूनहरू कायम रहन्छन्।
Gemma Answer: संविधान प्रारम्भ हुँदा प्रचलित कानूनहरू क्रमशः निष्क्रिय हुन गए।

Question: What happens to an existing law that is inconsistent with the Constitution after the specified transitional period?
Gold Answer: It becomes invalid to the extent of its inconsistency.

Question: संविधानसँग बाझिएको विद्यमान कानूनको तोकिएको संक्रमणकालीन अवधिपछि के हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: जति हदसम्म संविधानसँग बाझिन्छ, त्यति हदसम्म अमान्य हुन्छ।

Question: After what event and period does the inconsistency rule for existing laws take effect under Article 304(1)?
Gold Answer: After one year from the date on which the first session of the Federal Parliament is held, an inconsistent law becomes invalid to the extent of its inconsistency.
Gemma Answer: Upon the entry into force of the Constitution.

Question: धारा ३०४(१) अन्तर्गत विद्यमान कानूनको असंगतिसम्बन्धी व्यवस्था कुन घटना र अवधिपछि लागू हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: संघीय संसद्को पहिलो अधिवेशन बसेको मितिले एक वर्षपछि संविधानसँग बाझिएको कानून जति हदसम्म बाझिन्छ, त्यति हदसम्म अमान्य हुन्छ।

Question: How are Acts relating to the peace process under the Interim Constitution of Nepal, 2007 treated under the Constitution?
Gold Answer: They are deemed to have been done under the Constitution.
Gemma Answer: Acts relating to the peace process under the Interim Constitution of 2007 were considered subordinate to the Constitution and subject to its provisions regarding conflict resolution and transitional justice.

Question: नेपालको अन्तरिम संविधान, २०६३ अन्तर्गत शान्ति प्रक्रियासम्बन्धी कार्यहरूलाई संविधानअन्तर्गत कसरी मानिन्छ?
Gold Answer: संविधानअन्तर्गत गरिएको मानिन्छ।

Question: Who may issue necessary orders to remove difficulties in implementing the Constitution before the first session of the Federal Parliament?
Gold Answer: The President, on the recommendation of the Government of Nepal, Council of Ministers.

Question: संघीय संसद्को पहिलो अधिवेशनअघि संविधान कार्यान्वयनमा उत्पन्न कठिनाइ हटाउन आवश्यक आदेश कसले जारी गर्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer: नेपाल सरकार, मन्त्रिपरिषद्को सिफारिसमा राष्ट्रपतिले।

Question: What must happen to an order issued to remove difficulties under Article 305?
Gold Answer: It must be submitted for approval to the Legislature-Parliament or Federal Parliament that is held immediately after the order is issued.
Gemma Answer: It must be approved by the Court.

Question: धारा ३०५ अन्तर्गत कठिनाइ हटाउन जारी गरिएको आदेशको के गर्नुपर्छ?
Gold Answer: आदेश जारी भएपछि तुरुन्त बस्ने व्यवस्थापिका–संसद् वा संघीय संसद्समक्ष अनुमोदनका लागि पेश गर्नुपर्छ।

Question: Under Article 306, which groups are considered “minorities”?
Gold Answer: Minorities are ethnic, linguistic, and religious groups whose population is below the percentage specified by Federal law, including groups with distinct ethnic, religious, or linguistic characteristics and aspirations to protect them that have been subjected to discrimination and oppression.
Gemma Answer: Article 306 defines “minorities” as “all persons not belonging to the majority community.”

Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “अल्पसंख्यक” भन्नाले कुन समूहलाई जनाउँछ?
Gold Answer: संघीय कानूनले तोकेको प्रतिशतभन्दा कम जनसंख्या भएका जातीय, भाषिक र धार्मिक समूहहरू, साथै आफ्ना विशिष्ट जातीय, धार्मिक वा भाषिक विशेषता संरक्षण गर्ने आकांक्षा भएका र विभेद तथा उत्पीडनमा परेका समूहहरूलाई अल्पसंख्यक भनिन्छ।
Gemma Answer: जात, लिङ्ग, धर्म, वा सामाजिक उत्पत्तिको आधारमा कुनै समूह अल्पमतमा रहेको पाइँदा त्यस समूहका व्यक्तिहरू।

Question: What does the term “law” mean under Article 306 of the Constitution?
Gold Answer: “Law” means Federal law, State law, and Local law.
Gemma Answer: “Law” means a statute passed by the Parliament.

Question: संविधानको धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “कानून” भन्नाले के बुझिन्छ?
Gold Answer: “कानून” भन्नाले संघीय कानून, प्रदेश कानून र स्थानीय कानून बुझिन्छ।
Gemma Answer: संविधानको धारा ३०६ अनुसार, "कानून" भनेको संघीय संसदले बनाएको कानुन हो।

Question: What does the term “Article” refer to under Article 306?
Gold Answer: It means an Article of the Constitution.
Gemma Answer: A declaration of a state of public emergency.

Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “धारा” भन्नाले के जनाउँछ?
Gold Answer: संविधानको कुनै धारा।
Gemma Answer: आत्महतियार हुन मद्दत वा निम्त्याउने कार्य।

Question: What entities are included within the constitutional definition of “Municipality”?
Gold Answer: A Municipality includes a Municipal Corporation and a Sub-municipal Corporation.

Question: संवैधानिक रूपमा “नगरपालिका” को परिभाषाभित्र कुन निकायहरू पर्छन्?
Gold Answer: नगरपालिका भन्नाले महानगरपालिका र उपमहानगरपालिका समेत जनाउँछ।
Gemma Answer: नगरपालिकाको परिभाषा अनुसार, स्थानीय सरकारको निकायहरू।

Question: Who is considered a “citizen” under Article 306?
Gold Answer: A citizen means a citizen of Nepal.
Gemma Answer: A person born in the Philippines who at the time of his birth, is a national of the Philippines or whose parent is a Philippine national.

Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “नागरिक” भन्नाले कसलाई जनाउँछ?
Gold Answer: “नागरिक” भन्नाले नेपालको नागरिकलाई जनाउँछ।
Gemma Answer: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “नागरिक” भन्नाले कानुनले नागरिक दर्जा दिइएको व्यक्तिलाई जनाउँछ।

Question: How does Article 306 define the term “State”?
Gold Answer: “State” means the area and form of a federal unit of Nepal divided into federal units in accordance with the Constitution.
Gemma Answer: For the purposes of this Treaty, “State” means any entity capable of having international relations.

Question: धारा ३०६ ले “प्रदेश” शब्दलाई कसरी परिभाषित गरेको छ?
Gold Answer: “प्रदेश” भन्नाले संविधानबमोजिम संघीय इकाइहरूमा विभाजित नेपालको संघीय इकाइको क्षेत्र र स्वरूपलाई जनाउँछ।
Gemma Answer: प्रदेश भनेको राज्य वा राज्यको समूह हो।

Question: What does “remuneration” include under Article 306?
Gold Answer: It includes salary, allowance, pension, and any other form of emolument and facility.

Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “पारिश्रमिक” मा के–के समावेश हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: यसमा तलब, भत्ता, निवृत्तिभरण तथा अन्य कुनै पनि प्रकारको पारिश्रमिक र सुविधा समावेश हुन्छ।
Gemma Answer: यस अन्तर्गत भुक्तानी, क्षतिपूर्ति, वा क्षतिपूर्ति शुल्क समावेश हुन्छ।

Question: What powers are included within the meaning of “state power”?
Gold Answer: State power includes executive, legislative, and judicial powers of the State, as well as residual power.

Question: “राज्य शक्ति” भन्नाले कुन–कुन शक्ति समावेश भएको बुझिन्छ?
Gold Answer: राज्य शक्तिमा प्रदेशको कार्यपालिका, व्यवस्थापिका र न्यायपालिकासम्बन्धी शक्ति तथा अवशिष्ट शक्ति समावेश हुन्छ।
Gemma Answer: राज्य शक्ति भनेको कानुन बनाउने, कर लगाउने, ठगी नियन्त्रण गर्ने, रक्षा गर्ने र न्याय प्रदान गर्ने शक्ति समावेश हुन्छ।

Question: What does the term “Bill” mean under Article 306?
Gold Answer: It means a draft of an amendment to the Constitution or of an Act introduced in the Federal Parliament or a State Assembly.
Gemma Answer: A Bill is a proposed law presented to the Parliament for enactment.

Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “विधेयक” भन्नाले के बुझिन्छ?
Gold Answer: संघीय संसद् वा प्रदेश सभामा पेश गरिएको संविधान संशोधन वा ऐनको मस्यौदालाई विधेयक भनिन्छ।
Gemma Answer: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “विधेयक” भन्नाले संसद्ले बनाएको नयाँ कानुन बुझिन्छ।

Question: What is meant by “Federation” and “Federal Units” under Article 306?
Gold Answer: “Federation” means the federal level, which is the apex unit of the federal structure. “Federal Units” means the Federation, State, and Local levels.
Gemma Answer: “Federation” refers to the union of states. “Federal Units” are the individual states comprising the federation.

Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “संघ” र “संघीय इकाइ” भन्नाले के बुझिन्छ?
Gold Answer: “संघ” भन्नाले संघीय संरचनाको सर्वोच्च इकाइ अर्थात् संघीय तह बुझिन्छ। “संघीय इकाइ” भन्नाले संघ, प्रदेश र स्थानीय तह बुझिन्छ।
Gemma Answer: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “संघ” भन्नाले संघीय सरकार र “संघीय इकाइ” भन्नाले राज्य सरकारहरूलाई बुझिन्छ।

Question: Which institutions are included within the definition of “Constitutional Bodies” under Article 306?
Gold Answer: They include the Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority, Auditor General, Public Service Commission, Election Commission, National Human Rights Commission, National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission, National Women Commission, National Dalit Commission, National Inclusion Commission, Indigenous Nationalities Commission, Madhesi Commission, Tharu Commission, and Muslim Commission.
Gemma Answer:
Article 306 lists the following institutions as Constitutional Bodies:

*   The President of the Republic
*   The Prime Minister
*   The Council of Ministers
*   The Constitutional Court
*   The National Assembly
*   The Regions

Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “संवैधानिक निकाय” को परिभाषाभित्र कुन–कुन निकायहरू पर्छन्?
Gold Answer: अख्तियार दुरुपयोग अनुसन्धान आयोग, महालेखा परीक्षक, लोक सेवा आयोग, निर्वाचन आयोग, राष्ट्रिय मानव अधिकार आयोग, राष्ट्रिय प्राकृतिक स्रोत तथा वित्त आयोग, राष्ट्रिय महिला आयोग, राष्ट्रिय दलित आयोग, राष्ट्रिय समावेशी आयोग, आदिवासी जनजाति आयोग, मधेसी आयोग, थारू आयोग र मुस्लिम आयोग संवैधानिक निकायमा पर्छन्।
Gemma Answer: संविधान जारी गर्ने संसय, सर्वोच्च न्यायालय र राजपत्रले।

Question: Who are considered “marginalized” communities under Article 306?
Gold Answer: They are communities made politically, economically, and socially backward; unable to enjoy services and facilities because of discrimination, oppression, or geographical remoteness; or deprived of them; and having a status below the human development standards specified by Federal law. The definition also includes highly marginalized groups and groups on the verge of extinction.
Gemma Answer: Indigenous peoples and persons of African descent.

Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “सीमान्तीकृत” समुदाय भन्नाले कुन समुदायलाई जनाउँछ?
Gold Answer: राजनीतिक, आर्थिक र सामाजिक रूपमा पछाडि पारिएका; विभेद, उत्पीडन वा भौगोलिक विकटताका कारण सेवा तथा सुविधाको उपभोग गर्न नसकेका वा त्यस्ता सेवाबाट वञ्चित भएका; तथा संघीय कानूनमा उल्लिखित मानव विकासको मापदण्डभन्दा न्यून अवस्थामा रहेका समुदायलाई सीमान्तीकृत समुदाय भनिन्छ। यसमा अति सीमान्तीकृत र लोपोन्मुख समूहहरू समेत पर्छन्।

Question: What entities are included within the term “Local level” under Article 306?
Gold Answer: It means Village Bodies, Municipalities, and District Assemblies established in accordance with the Constitution.

Question: धारा ३०६ अन्तर्गत “स्थानीय तह” भन्नाले कुन निकायहरूलाई जनाउँछ?
Gold Answer: संविधानबमोजिम स्थापना हुने गाउँ निकाय, नगरपालिका र जिल्ला सभालाई स्थानीय तह भनिन्छ।
Gemma Answer: स्थानीय तहको निर्वाचन क्षेत्रमा प्रतिनिधित्व गरिने गाउँपालिका, नगरपालिका र त्यसरी गठन हुने अन्य स्थानीय निकायहरू।

Question: How are legal provisions relating to the interpretation of laws applied when interpreting the Constitution?
Gold Answer: Subject to the provisions of the Constitution, the legal provisions relating to the interpretation of laws apply to the interpretation of the Constitution in the same manner as they apply to the interpretation of Nepalese laws.
Gemma Answer: Constitutional interpretation relies on principles like textualism, originalism, and living constitutionalism, each influencing how provisions are understood.

Question: संविधानको व्याख्या गर्दा कानूनको व्याख्यासम्बन्धी कानूनी व्यवस्थाहरू कसरी लागू हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer: संविधानका प्रावधानहरूको अधीनमा रही कानूनको व्याख्यासम्बन्धी कानूनी व्यवस्था नेपालको कानूनको व्याख्या गर्दा लागू हुने समान तरिकाले संविधानको व्याख्यामा लागू हुन्छ।
Gemma Answer: संविधानको व्याख्या गर्दा कानूनको व्याख्यासम्बन्धी कानूनी व्यवस्था (जैसे कि judicial precedent) लागू हुन्छ।

Question: What is the short title of the Constitution, when did it commence, and which previous Constitution did it repeal?
Gold Answer: It may be cited as the “Constitution of Nepal”; it commenced on 20 September 2015 (3 Ashwin 2072 Bikram Sambat); and it repealed the Interim Constitution of Nepal, 2007 (2063).
Gemma Answer:
Articles of Confederation
March 4, 1789
No previous constitution – it was the first.

Question: संविधानको छोटो नाम के हो, यो कहिले प्रारम्भ भयो र यसले कुन अघिल्लो संविधान खारेज गर्‍यो?
Gold Answer: यसको छोटो नाम “नेपालको संविधान” हो; यो २० सेप्टेम्बर २०१५ (वि.सं. २०७२ असोज ३ गते) प्रारम्भ भयो; र यसले नेपालको अन्तरिम संविधान, २०६३ खारेज गर्‍यो।
Gemma Answer:
संविधानको छोटो नाम: नेपाली संविधान
प्रारम्भ: २०७० पुस १५
खारेज गरेको संविधान: २०६३ असोज ११ (संविधानको पहिलो संशोधन)

Question: What is the short title of the Act?
Gold Answer: Right to Information Act, 2064 B.S. (2007 A.D.).

Question: यस ऐनको छोटो नाम के हो?
Gold Answer: सूचनाको हक सम्बन्धी ऐन, २०६४ (सन् २००७)।

Question: On what day after certification does the Right to Information Act, 2064 come into force?
Gold Answer: The 30th day after certification.

Question: सूचनाको हक सम्बन्धी ऐन, २०६४ प्रमाणीकरण भएको कति दिनपछि लागू हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: प्रमाणीकरण भएको ३०औँ दिन।

Question: Under the Act, what is meant by a “Public Body”?
Gold Answer: Any body or institution included in the categories listed in Section 2(a).
Gemma Answer: A “Public Body” means a body which is established by or exercises powers under an Act of Parliament.

Question: ऐनअनुसार “सार्वजनिक निकाय” भन्नाले के बुझिन्छ?
Gold Answer: दफा २(क) मा उल्लिखित वर्गमा पर्ने कुनै निकाय वा संस्था।
Gemma Answer: सार्वजनिक निकाय भन्नाले सरकारले स्थापित गरेको संस्था वा निकायलाई बुझिन्छ।

Question: Which type of body is included as a Public Body because it is established under the Constitution?
Gold Answer: A body under the Constitution.

Question: संविधानअन्तर्गत स्थापित कुन प्रकारको निकाय सार्वजनिक निकायमा पर्छ?
Gold Answer: संविधानअन्तर्गतको निकाय।

Question: Is a body established by an Act included within the definition of a Public Body?
Gold Answer: Yes.

Question: ऐनद्वारा स्थापित निकाय सार्वजनिक निकायको परिभाषाभित्र पर्छ कि पर्दैन?
Gold Answer: पर्छ।

Question: What type of body formed by the Government of Nepal is included as a Public Body?
Gold Answer: A body formed by the Government of Nepal.

Question: नेपाल सरकारद्वारा गठन गरिएको कुन प्रकारको निकाय सार्वजनिक निकायमा पर्छ?
Gold Answer: नेपाल सरकारद्वारा गठन गरिएको निकाय।

Question: What is the distinction between the first three categories of Public Body under Section 2(a): a body under the Constitution, a body established by an Act, and a body formed by the Government of Nepal?
Gold Answer: They are respectively a body under the Constitution, a body established by an Act, and a body formed by the Government of Nepal.
Gemma Answer:
*   **Body under the Constitution:** Created directly by the Constitution of Nepal.
*   **Body established by an Act:** Created by a specific Act of Parliament.
*   **Body formed by the Government of Nepal:** Established through government regulations and directives.

Question: दफा २(क) अन्तर्गत सार्वजनिक निकायका पहिलो तीन वर्गबीच के भिन्नता छ?
Gold Answer: ती क्रमशः संविधानअन्तर्गतको निकाय, ऐनद्वारा स्थापित निकाय र नेपाल सरकारद्वारा गठन गरिएको निकाय हुन्।
Gemma Answer: संसद, राज्य सभा, र प्रदेश सभा।

Question: Does the definition of Public Body include an institution or foundation established by law for public service?
Gold Answer: Yes.

Question: सार्वजनिक सेवाका लागि कानूनद्वारा स्थापित संस्था वा प्रतिष्ठान सार्वजनिक निकायको परिभाषामा पर्छ?
Gold Answer: पर्छ।

Question: Which political organizations are included within the definition of a Public Body under the Act?
Gold Answer: Political parties or organizations registered under the relevant law.
Gemma Answer: Local authorities, government departments, and NHS bodies.

Question: ऐनअनुसार कुन राजनीतिक संगठनहरू सार्वजनिक निकायको परिभाषाभित्र पर्छन्?
Gold Answer: सम्बन्धित कानूनअन्तर्गत दर्ता भएका राजनीतिक दल वा संगठनहरू।
Gemma Answer: कानुनको दफा ३(२) बमोज्य, सार्वजनिक निकाय भनेको सरकारको हिस्सा वा सरकारको अधिकार प्रयोग गर्ने राजनीतिक दलहरू हुन्।

Question: Under what ownership or control conditions is a body corporate included as a Public Body?
Gold Answer: When it is wholly or partly owned by, or under the control of, the Government of Nepal or a body receiving grants from the Government of Nepal.
Gemma Answer: When it exercises sovereign powers or functions.

Question: कुन स्वामित्व वा नियन्त्रणको अवस्थामा कुनै निकायगत संस्था सार्वजनिक निकायमा पर्छ?
Gold Answer: नेपाल सरकारको पूर्ण वा आंशिक स्वामित्वमा वा नियन्त्रणमा रहेको, वा नेपाल सरकारबाट अनुदान प्राप्त गर्ने त्यस्तो निकायको स्वामित्व वा नियन्त्रणमा रहेको अवस्थामा।

Question: Can a body corporate formed by another body established by the Government of Nepal or by law be considered a Public Body, and what additional condition is specified?
Gold Answer: Yes, when it is formed by such a body upon entering into an agreement.
Gemma Answer: Yes, if the body corporate is established by the Government of Nepal or by law, and it is *primarily* for the administration of public affairs.

Question: नेपाल सरकार वा कानूनद्वारा स्थापित निकायले सम्झौता गरी गठन गरेको निकायगत संस्था सार्वजनिक निकाय मानिन सक्छ?
Gold Answer: सक्छ, त्यस्तो निकायले सम्झौता गरी गठन गरेको अवस्थामा।

Question: What type of non-governmental organization or institution is included as a Public Body?
Gold Answer: One operated with money obtained directly or indirectly from the Government of Nepal, a foreign government, or an international organization or institution.

Question: कस्तो गैरसरकारी संस्था वा संगठन सार्वजनिक निकायमा पर्छ?
Gold Answer: नेपाल सरकार, विदेशी सरकार वा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय संगठन वा संस्थाबाट प्रत्यक्ष वा अप्रत्यक्ष रूपमा प्राप्त रकमबाट सञ्चालित संस्था वा संगठन।

Question: What is the key difference between the Public Body categories concerning a body corporate under government ownership or control and a non-governmental organization receiving funds?
Gold Answer: The former is included based on specified ownership or control, while the latter is included based on operation using money obtained from specified governments or international organizations or institutions.
Gemma Answer: A body corporate under government ownership/control is subject to government accountability and oversight, while an NGO receiving funds is primarily accountable to its donors and beneficiaries.

Question: सरकारी स्वामित्व वा नियन्त्रणमा रहेको निकायगत संस्था र रकम प्राप्त गर्ने गैरसरकारी संस्थाबीच सार्वजनिक निकायको परिभाषामा मुख्य भिन्नता के हो?
Gold Answer: पहिलो वर्ग निर्दिष्ट स्वामित्व वा नियन्त्रणका आधारमा समावेश हुन्छ भने दोस्रो वर्ग निर्दिष्ट सरकार वा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय संगठन वा संस्थाबाट प्राप्त रकमबाट सञ्चालित भएको आधारमा समावेश हुन्छ।
Gemma Answer: सरकारी निकायले गैरसरकारी संस्थालाई वित्तीय सहायता वा रकम दिदा, सरकारी निकायको परिभाषामा मुख्य भिन्नता यो हुन्छ: नियन्त्रण वा प्रभावमाथि कुनै ह्रास नहुनु।

Question: How may the Government of Nepal designate an additional body or institution as a Public Body beyond the categories expressly listed in Section 2(a)?
Gold Answer: By publishing a notice in the Gazette.
Gemma Answer: Through an amendment to the Public Bodies Act.

Question: दफा २(क) मा स्पष्ट रूपमा उल्लिखित वर्गबाहेक नेपाल सरकारले थप कुनै निकाय वा संस्थालाई कसरी सार्वजनिक निकाय तोक्न सक्छ?
Gold Answer: राजपत्रमा सूचना प्रकाशित गरेर।

Question: A body does not fall within any of the first eight listed categories of Public Body. Under what condition can it still be treated as a Public Body under the Act?
Gold Answer: If the Government of Nepal prescribes it as a Public Body by publishing a notice in the Gazette.
Gemma Answer: If it has the requisite characteristics of a public body as defined in the Act.

Question: कुनै निकाय सार्वजनिक निकायका पहिलो आठ वर्गमध्ये कुनैमा पर्दैन भने कुन अवस्थामा त्यसलाई ऐनअनुसार सार्वजनिक निकाय मान्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer: नेपाल सरकारले राजपत्रमा सूचना प्रकाशित गरी त्यसलाई सार्वजनिक निकायका रूपमा तोकेमा।

Question: Under the Act, what does “Information” mean?
Gold Answer: Any written document, material, or information related to the functions, proceedings, or decisions of public importance made by a Public Body.
Gemma Answer: “Information” means any data, record, or other material, regardless of the form in which it is contained.

Question: ऐनअनुसार “सूचना” भन्नाले के बुझिन्छ?
Gold Answer: सार्वजनिक निकायका कार्य, कार्यवाही वा सार्वजनिक महत्वका निर्णयसँग सम्बन्धित कुनै लिखित दस्तावेज, सामग्री वा सूचना।
Gemma Answer: कानूनको पालना गर्ने उद्देश्यको लागि दिइएको लिखित वा मुद्रित विवरण।

Question: What does “Public Importance” mean under the Act?
Gold Answer: A subject directly or indirectly related to the interest of citizens.
Gemma Answer: “Public importance” means a matter of general or public interest.

Question: ऐनअनुसार “सार्वजनिक महत्व” भन्नाले के बुझिन्छ?
Gold Answer: नागरिकको हितसँग प्रत्यक्ष वा अप्रत्यक्ष रूपमा सम्बन्धित विषय।
Gemma Answer: सार्वजनिक महत्व भनेको देशको सुरक्षा, स्थिरता, लोकतन्त्र, सामाजिक सद्भाव, वा मौलिक अधिकारसँग सम्बन्धित कुरा हो।

Question: What types of materials are included within the definition of a “Document”?
Gold Answer: Any kind of written document, including audiovisual material collected and updated through mechanical means or material that can be printed or retrieved.

Question: “दस्तावेज” को परिभाषाभित्र कस्ता सामग्रीहरू समावेश हुन्छन्?
Gold Answer: जुनसुकै प्रकारको लिखित दस्तावेज तथा यान्त्रिक माध्यमबाट संकलन र अद्यावधिक गरिएको वा छाप्न वा पुनःप्राप्त गर्न सकिने श्रव्यदृश्य सामग्री।
Gemma Answer: दस्तावेजमा लिखित, मुद्रित, वा डिजिटल रूपमा रेकर्ड गरिएको कुनै पनि सामग्री समावेश हुन्छ, जस्तै कागजात, रिपोर्ट, पत्र, म्याल्स, तस्वीर, भिडियो, आदि।

Question: How does the Act distinguish “Information” from a “Document”?
Gold Answer: Information concerns material related to the functions, proceedings, or decisions of public importance of a Public Body, while a Document refers to written or specified audiovisual or mechanically stored or retrievable material.
Gemma Answer: The Act defines “Information” as data, and a “Document” as information recorded in a tangible form.

Question: ऐनले “सूचना” र “दस्तावेज” बीच कसरी भिन्नता गर्छ?
Gold Answer: सूचना सार्वजनिक निकायका कार्य, कार्यवाही वा सार्वजनिक महत्वका निर्णयसँग सम्बन्धित सामग्री हो भने दस्तावेज लिखित वा निर्दिष्ट श्रव्यदृश्य वा यान्त्रिक रूपमा संकलित, छाप्न वा पुनःप्राप्त गर्न सकिने सामग्री हो।
Gemma Answer: कानूनी सन्दर्भमा, "सूचना" भनेको कुनै तथ्यको मूल रूपमा उल्लेख नगरी दिइएको जानकारी हो, जबकि "दस्तावेज" भनेको भSebelum कागजी वा इलेक्ट्रोनिक माध्यममा रेकर्ड गरिएको लिखित वा दृश्य सामग्री हो।

Question: What is the basic right included within the definition of “Right to Information”?
Gold Answer: The right to ask for and obtain information of public importance held by Public Bodies.

Question: “सूचनाको हक” को परिभाषामा समावेश मूलभूत हक के हो?
Gold Answer: सार्वजनिक निकायमा रहेको सार्वजनिक महत्वको सूचना माग्ने र प्राप्त गर्ने हक।

Question: Besides asking for and obtaining information, what right concerning written documents or materials held by a Public Body is included in the Right to Information?
Gold Answer: The right to study or observe them.

Question: सूचना माग्ने र प्राप्त गर्ने अधिकारबाहेक सार्वजनिक निकायमा रहेका लिखित दस्तावेज वा सामग्रीसम्बन्धी कुन अधिकार सूचनाको हकमा समावेश हुन्छ?
Gold Answer: तिनको अध्ययन वा अवलोकन गर्ने हक।

Question: What may a person obtain regarding a document under the Right to Information?
Gold Answer: A verified copy of the document.
Gemma Answer: A person may obtain copies of the document, along with associated information.

Question: सूचनाको हकअन्तर्गत कुनै दस्तावेजका सम्बन्धमा के प्राप्त गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer: प्रमाणित प्रतिलिपि।

Question: What access does the Right to Information provide concerning a place where construction of public importance is taking place?
Gold Answer: The right to visit or observe the place.
Gemma Answer: The Right to Information provides access to information related to the planning, execution, and monitoring of construction projects of public importance, including contracts, permits, and associated costs.

Question: सार्वजनिक महत्वको निर्माण कार्य भइरहेको स्थानका सम्बन्धमा सूचनाको हकले कस्तो पहुँच प्रदान गर्छ?
Gold Answer: त्यस्तो स्थानमा भ्रमण वा अवलोकन गर्ने हक।
Gemma Answer: सूचनाको हकले सम्बन्धित ठाउँमा निर्माण कार्यको बारेमा जानकारी पाउने अधिकार प्रदान गर्छ।

Question: What may be obtained as evidence or information about materials used in construction of public importance under the Right to Information?
Gold Answer: A verified sample of the material.
Gemma Answer: Specifications, drawings, contracts, invoices, and payment records.

Question: सार्वजनिक महत्वको निर्माणमा प्रयोग भएका सामग्रीका सम्बन्धमा सूचनाको हकअन्तर्गत के प्राप्त गर्न सकिन्छ?
Gold Answer: सामग्रीको प्रमाणित नमुना।

Question: What additional access does the Right to Information provide to information held in any type of machine?
Gold Answer: The right to obtain the information through that machine.
Gemma Answer: The Right to Information does not automatically grant access to information held within machines.

Question: कुनै पनि प्रकारको यन्त्रमा रहेको सूचनाका सम्बन्धमा सूचनाको हकले कस्तो पहुँच प्रदान गर्छ?
Gold Answer: त्यस्तो यन्त्रमार्फत सूचना प्राप्त गर्ने हक।
Gemma Answer: सूचनाको हकले यन्त्रमा रहेका सूचनाहरूमा पहुँच प्रदान गर्छ।

Question: Which of the following forms of access are expressly included in the statutory definition of the Right to Information: studying or observing documents, obtaining a verified copy, observing public-interest construction, obtaining a verified material sample, or obtaining machine-held information through the machine?
Gold Answer: All of them.
Gemma Answer: Studying or observing documents, obtaining a verified copy.

Question: निम्नमध्ये कुन-कुन पहुँचका स्वरूपहरू सूचनाको हकको वैधानिक परिभाषामा स्पष्ट रूपमा समावेश छन्: दस्तावेज अध्ययन वा अवलोकन गर्नु, प्रमाणित प्रतिलिपि प्राप्त गर्नु, सार्वजनिक महत्वको निर्माण अवलोकन गर्नु, प्रमाणित सामग्रीको नमुना प्राप्त गर्नु, वा यन्त्रमा रहेको सूचना सोही यन्त्रमार्फत प्राप्त गर्नु?
Gold Answer: यी सबै।
Gemma Answer: दस्तावेज अध्ययन वा अवलोकन, प्रमाणित प्रतिलिपि प्राप्त गर्नु, सार्वजनिक महत्वको निर्माण अवलोकन गर्नु, प्रमाणित सामग्रीको नमुना प्राप्त गर्नु, र यन्त्रमा रहेको सूचना सोही यन्त्रमार्फत प्राप्त गर्नु।

Question: Who is an “Information Authority” under the Act?
Gold Answer: A person appointed pursuant to Section 6.
Gemma Answer: An “Information Authority” is a government agency or department.

Question: ऐनअनुसार “सूचना अधिकारी” को हो?
Gold Answer: दफा ६ बमोजिम नियुक्त व्यक्ति।

Question: Who is referred to as the “Chief” under the Act?
Gold Answer: The Chief of a Public Body.

Question: ऐनअनुसार “प्रमुख” भन्नाले कसलाई जनाउँछ?
Gold Answer: सार्वजनिक निकायको प्रमुख।
Gemma Answer: ऐन अनुसार “प्रमुख” भन्नाले प्रतिनिधिसँगको सम्बन्धमा राजनीतिक शक्ति प्रयोग गर्ने व्यक्तिलाई जनाउँछ।

Question: What does the term “Commission” refer to under the Act?
Gold Answer: The National Information Commission constituted pursuant to Section 11.
Gemma Answer: A payment to an independent contractor for services rendered.

Question: ऐनअनुसार “आयोग” भन्नाले के जनाउँछ?
Gold Answer: दफा ११ बमोजिम गठन भएको राष्ट्रिय सूचना आयोग।
Gemma Answer: आयोग भनेको निश्चित मात्रामा रकमको एक निश्चित प्रतिशत।
